item.description:
Two new breaks, honest numbers.

New

  • New exercise “Eye Movement”: your gaze follows a travelling dot — on by default
  • New exercise “Window Gaze”: look outside and find one thing you never noticed
  • FocusTimer can start at login, switchable in Settings

Improved

  • Fuller, less beepy tones — the two shriller sound profiles are gone
  • Every exercise ends the same way, and each setting sits under its exercise's name
  • FocusTimer now runs on macOS 26.1 instead of requiring 26.3

Fixed

  • Breaks were counted twice, or as the wrong kind, in your statistics
  • The daily check for updates was invisible and could not be switched off
